synthesis.guidance: Choose multiple=true for independent filters or reference sections, and a single controlled value for mutually exclusive setup panels. The inspected props include loop for arrow-key wraparound and order for h2–h6 wrappers around controls; match order to the document outline, not font size. The default transition duration is 200ms: derive motion from the product and provide an appropriate reduced-motion alternative. Use separated or contained variants only when grouping is meaningful; a dense settings page often needs simple rows rather than rounded containers everywhere. Maintain value types when switching between single and multiple modes. Excerpts describe an internal prop contract and defaults, not a complete composition or installed dependency. These props alone do not guarantee accessibility.
